authorInfo.bio: George Crabbe (1754–1832) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Tales" by George Crabbe is a collection of poetic narratives written during the late 18th to early 19th century. The poems explore various human experiences and societal issues through engaging characters and moral lessons.
